newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani arrested with heroin at Karachi airport.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani arrested with heroin at Karachi airport.

text.p: A Pakistani man was arrested at Karachi airport after 24 kg (53 lb) of heroin was found in his bags, a customs spokesman said on Monday.
The man, identified as Hyder Khan, had intended to board a flight to Bishkek, capital of the Central Asian republic of Kyrgyzstan , the spokesman said.
A customs official said the seized heroin had an estimated street value of more than $2.4 million.
